column1: # Egyptian Arabic (arz) SHORT-VOWEL / vocalization lexicon — bare word ⇥ canonical Egyptian IPA, mined from

# ق→ʔ, plain s, majhūl o/e KEPT (the value the abjad g2p can't recover), narrow marks stripped + æ/ɪ/ʊ/ɾ/ɜ/ə/ɛ →
